All Bucket A P7 findings fixed, adversarially verified, and shipped CI-green:
- synckit v0.18.0 (83f7aeb): meshtrust deterministic fail-closed on DNS-name collisions (peer-vs-peer AND self-vs-peer)
- cc-orchestrate c0f7b76: respawnAgent kills the just-spawned terminal on incarnation-persist failure (DB-read-free, WithoutCancel)
- cc-runtime 321e5db (6 commits): rpc stdin-only + no payload/caller-value in errors (A1/A3); APNs device-token never logged (A6); empty ask/notify rejected pre-gate (A7); hostadd rolls back only the added host, Self idempotent (A8); iOS https+fp enforcement on the bearer leg (B1); synckit v0.18.0 bump
- cc-present 3e0636c: RequireJSON Content-Type gate on tokenless state-changing POSTs + v0.18.0 bump

Process notes: round 1 fixes had residuals the codex verify caught (incl. an A3 fix-induced stderr credential leak); round 2 closed them; opus (codex quota-blocked until Jul 24) independently verified round 2 and caught the A8 same-self clobber; A8 round 3 (never-revert-Self) opus-verified CLOSED. Full triage in note af393601.

DEFERRED GATE: codex cross-model re-verification of the whole P7 fix set to re-run at quota reset (Jul 24) before declaring P7 fully closed — opus stood in but cross-model diversity was lost this window.
